mn91:26.4: na kho metaṃ paṭirūpaṃ yohaṃ pubbe appaṭisaṃvidito samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyanti.
mn91:26.5: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo aññataraṃ māṇavakaṃ āmantesi
mn91:26.6: ehi tvaṃ māṇavaka yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkama upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha
mn91:26.7: brahmāyu bho gotama brāhmaṇo bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatīti
mn91:26.9: brahmāyu bho gotama brāhmaṇo jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto vīsavassasatiko jātiyā tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyata mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo
mn91:26.10: yāvatā bho brāhmaṇagahapatikā mithilāyaṃ paṭivasanti brahmāyu tesaṃ brāhmaṇo aggamakkhāyati
mn91:26.17: evaṃ bhoti kho so māṇavako brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
mn91:26.18: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho māṇavako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn91:26.19: brahmāyu bho gotama brāhmaṇo bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati
mn91:26.21: brahmāyu bho gotama brāhmaṇo jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto vīsavassasatiko jātiyā tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo
mn91:26.22: yāvatā bho brāhmaṇagahapatikā mithilāyaṃ paṭivasanti brahmāyu tesaṃ brāhmaṇo aggamakkhāyati
mn91:26.29: yassadāni māṇava brahmāyu brāhmaṇo kālaṃ maññatīti.
mn91:27.1: atha kho so māṇavako yena brahmāyu brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca
mn91:28.1: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami.
mn91:28.2: addasā kho sā parisā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ
mn91:28.3: disvā oramattha okāsamakāsi yathātaṃ ñātassa yasassino.
mn91:28.4: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo taṃ parisaṃ etadavoca
mn91:29.1: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
mn91:29.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn91:29.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni sammannesi.
mn91:29.4: addasā kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve
mn91:29.5: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na saṃpasīdati
mn91:29.7: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi
mn91:30.2: passati kho me ayaṃ brahmāyu brāhmaṇo dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve
mn91:30.3: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na saṃpasīdati
mn91:30.5: atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāresi yathā addasa brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavato kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ.
mn91:30.6: atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubhopi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi paṭimasi ubhopi nāsikasotāni anumasi paṭimasi kevalakappaṃ nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
mn91:30.7: atha kho bhagavā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi
mn91:32.3: kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ puccheyyaṃ
mn91:32.8: yannūnāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ samparāyikameva atthaṃ puccheyyanti.
mn91:32.9: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi
mn91:33.1: atha kho bhagavā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gāthāhi paccabhāsi
mn91:34.1: evaṃ vutte brahmāyu brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavato pādāni mukhena ca paricumbati pāṇīhi parisambāhati nāmañca sāveti
mn91:35.1: atha kho sā parisā acchariyabbhūtajātā ahosi
mn91:35.2: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhūtaṃ vata bho samaṇassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā
mn91:35.3: yatra hi nāmāyaṃ brahmāyu brāhmaṇo ñāto yasassī evarūpaṃ paramaṃ nipaccakāraṃ karissatīti.
mn91:35.4: atha kho bhagavā brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca
mn91:35.5: alaṃ brāhmaṇa uṭṭhaha nisīda tvaṃ sake āsane yato te mayi cittaṃ pasannanti.
mn91:35.6: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo uṭṭhahitvā sake āsane nisīdi.
mn91:36.1: atha kho bhagavā brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyathīdaṃ
mn91:36.3: kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
mn91:36.4: yadā bhagavā aññāsi brahmāyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi
mn91:36.6: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya
mn91:36.7: evameva brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa tasmiṃyeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
mn91:36.9: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthu sāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn91:37.1: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama
mn91:37.2: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
mn91:37.3: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
mn91:37.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgataṃ
mn91:37.5: adhivāsetu ca me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
mn91:37.7: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
mn91:38.1: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi
mn91:38.2: kālo kho bho gotama niṭṭhitaṃ bhattanti.
mn91:38.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena brahmāyussa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
mn91:38.4: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo sattāhaṃ buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
mn91:39.1: atha kho bhagavā tassa sattāhassa accayena videhesu cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
mn91:39.2: atha kho brahmāyu brāhmaṇo acirapakkantassa bhagavato kālamakāsi.
mn91:39.3: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
mn91:39.6: paṇḍito bhikkhave brahmāyu brāhmaṇo paccapādi dhammaṃ sānudhammaṃ neva maṃ dhammādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi
mn91:39.7: brahmāyu brāhmaṇo pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tatthaparinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokāti.
mn91:39.9: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
